The plan body: a login as agent is the sponsor's lease, carved under alice's sub-budget, deadline MAX_LEASE, end_lease and the notice from her sessions. The server cannot do it: the core picks the parent (carve_session: Parent::Sub(own domain)), the deadline (none for a session), the kind (EndLease routes only to Kind::Lease, made by StartAgent/Granted) and the guard (sponsor_session compares accounts). The brief's "Not yours: the core's guards, rows" conflicts with the plan body; the launch allows the core and oracle "unchanged or extended". Arithmetic: alice's {} share (23,811 pages) holds two sessions; a third needs agent's 24,576 pages/20 processes folded into alice's top (36,100 per set, 3 sessions) and her contexts cap raised; agent-login's `users/agent/{}` expectations move. Options: (A) core: `principal` line gains sponsor=NAME (init writes/checks it); a sponsored principal gets no top budget; its Login runs the session machine as today but carve_session parents at the sponsor's unlabelled sub-budget with deadline now+MAX_LEASE; the session stays in its own domain (audit 1003/{}; kernel account inherited = R8); new session rows: Running/Detached x EndLease(ahead) guarded sponsor_of -> Ending with audit_lease_ended, notify_sponsor, reply_ok, destroy_budget; every exit of a sponsored session adds notify_sponsor aimed at the sponsor's unlabelled domain. (B) core: a sponsored login is a Lease object in alice's domain, the lease machine growing the context rows: much larger. (C) defer the conversion to a follow-up node; agent stays in name only. I recommend (A); it touches manifest/store/guards/effects/tables, the oracle (guards.ex, effects.ex, new traces: run-traces fails on an untaken row), the model's reach table, init's field and init.md, SECURITY.md R39. > Q2 ruling: (A). Full text (rules, ownership, arithmetic, your start_agent picks): .wash/local/STEWARD3A-Q2-ruling.md. Build from it.
> 
> Why: agents.md already states the sponsored principal (its own principal, never an impersonation; budget under the sponsor's, R8; the sponsor can end it; a crash loop stops at the sponsor); (A) is that page made mechanism with the session machine kept, so the harness sees a session. (B) moves the agent's audit into alice's domain; (C) leaves AGENT0 in name only when the owner's order is STEWARD3 now.
> 
> Rules: `sponsor=NAME` on the principal line (init checks: another principal, not itself, not itself sponsored; no chains here); no top budget; carve_session at the sponsor's unlabelled sub-budget with deadline now+MAX_LEASE; a sponsored login in a labelled set is refused `labelled`; the session stays in its own domain, ids from the one id space, EndLease names the session's id; your rows and guard as written, every leave of Running/Detached adding notify_sponsor aimed at the sponsor's unlabelled domain; the login reply stays `session-N`; `lease_ended.name` is `<principal>/<name>` for every lease.
> 
> Ownership: libs/steward, the oracle (no untaken row) and the model's families are yours here; core, oracle and model move together. The reach table is re-recorded only for rows reached through the fixed manifest, which gains one sponsored principal: no new random draw; quote the families' seed times against MODEL1's. 3R step 2 rebases onto you.
> 
> Arithmetic: fold agent's top into alice's; the constraint for image/README.md: alice's {} holds her console, one SSH session, the sponsored session and one sizes.agent lease at once; sizes.agent is measured (twice the agent VM's idle peak + outside-heap, rounded to 128), not 4,096; the vault set gives way only while it keeps two sessions, else bring the numbers here.
